reference.name: PyJHora
reference.license: AGPL-3.0 (wheel LICENSE and metadata); pyproject declares an MIT classifier, which conflicts with the bundled license text
reference.scope: Varga sign mapping only. The pinned chart transformation functions were executed from the exact source commit; no PyJHora ephemeris or birth-chart calculation was executed.
reference.inputs: Synthetic sidereal longitudes passed as PyJHora (source sign index, degrees within sign). Ayanamsa/time/location are not applicable to a mapping-only comparison.
reference.settings: Named divisional chart methods use PyJHora chart_method=1 except D2, which uses chart_method=2 for its documented Traditional Parasara Hora matching LIFE. Unnamed LIFE custom divisions use PyJHora custom_divisional_chart(base_rasi=None), whose documented cyclic mapping matches the selected LIFE custom rule.
reference.boundary: For all charts compare probes 1e-7 degrees before and after each segment boundary, covering all 12 source signs and all segments. Exact equal-division boundary probes are excluded from the PyJHora comparison because its float floor-division implementation occasionally assigns the previous segment at mathematically exact boundaries; LIFE exact-boundary ownership is checked separately by deterministic tests. D30 exact boundaries are also excluded because PyJHora includes upper bounds while LIFE uses half-open segments.
reference.planetaryPositions: No independent natal ephemeris positions were calculated; therefore this fixture validates D2-D60 sign mapping, not end-to-end birth-chart positions or D1 houses.
